title: Leveraging AI for Direct Bystander Intervention Against Cyberbullying
reasoning: The paper focuses on evaluating the effectiveness of an AI-assisted tool (EmojiGen) for bystander intervention in cyberbullying. While it discusses psychological concepts like 'personal responsibility' and 'moral intent' and includes a section on 'Ethical Considerations,' it does not evaluate or benchmark religious beliefs, faith, or the moral reasoning capabilities of LLMs.
